title: Learn the Letters
sequence_note: Letters follow the UFLI alphabet order, taught in groups of 4 (the last group has 2). Every word uses only letters already taught. Children read real words on Day 1.

heart_words.a: Heart word. On its own, a usually sounds like /uh/ (a mat). Tap the heart and say: this one we know by heart.
heart_words.the: Heart word. t and h together are not taught yet. Read it by heart: the.
heart_words.is: Heart word. The s says /z/ here. i is regular, s is the tricky heart part.
heart_words.I: Heart word. Capital I says its name, and it is always a capital.
heart_words.to: Heart word. The o says /oo/ here. t is regular.
heart_words.his: Heart word for now. The s says /z/.
heart_words.has: Heart word for now. The s says /z/.
heart_words.of: Heart word. It sounds like /uv/. Both letters are tricky.
heart_words.you: Heart word. y is regular. ou says /oo/ here.
heart_words.was: Heart word. Sounds like /wuz/. The a and s are tricky.
heart_words.said: Heart word. Sounds like /sed/. ai is the tricky part.

letters.concept: A round green-and-gold apple snail. Her curled shell is the round part of the a and her tall neck is the straight stick on the right.
letters.chant: Asa the apple snail opens wide: /a/ /a/ /a/!
letters.action: Open your mouth wide in surprise and pop one hand up from a fist, like Asa peeking out of her shell.
letters.formation: Start just under the middle line. Curve back and around like a circle and close it. Go back up and pull straight down.

letters.concept: A smiling mangrove tree. His trunk is the first stick and his two arched roots make the two humps of the m. He holds an Okinawa mango.
letters.action: Rub your tummy in a circle and hum /mmm/ with lips closed.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line and pull down. Go back up, hump over and down. Back up again, hump over and down.

letters.concept: A friendly blue-and-white banded sea snake curled into an s, head at the top curve and paddle tail at the bottom.
letters.action: Slide your hand like a snake in an s path while you hiss /sss/.
letters.formation: Start just under the middle line on the right. Curve back to the left, swing across to the right, then curve back at the bottom. Slide like Sami.

letters.concept: A young green sea turtle standing tall. Her body is the stick, her flippers stretch out as the cross line, and her tail hooks to the right at the bottom.
letters.action: Hold arms out like flippers and tap two fingers on your palm for each /t/.
letters.formation: Start at the top line and pull straight down, then hook to the right. Lift your pencil and cross at the middle line.

letters.concept: A round spotted pufferfish puffed up at the top right of a long straight tail that drops below the line.
letters.action: Puff your cheeks, then pop the air out with a tiny /p/ on your hand.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line and pull straight down below the bottom line. Go back up and curve around to close.

letters.concept: A curly tree fern from the island forest. The top of the frond curls over like the hook of an f and a leafy band crosses the middle.
letters.chant: Fumi the fern fans the air: /fff/!
letters.action: Gently bite your bottom lip and blow /fff/ while your fingers flutter like fern leaves.
letters.formation: Start a little below the top line. Curve up and over to the left, then pull straight down. Lift and cross at the middle line.

letters.concept: A little green inchworm standing straight up on a twig with a shiny dewdrop floating above his head.
letters.action: Inch one finger up your arm, saying /i/ with each step.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line and pull straight down. Lift and add the dot above.

letters.concept: A cheerful Okinawa soba noodle bent into one tall hump, steam curling off the top.
letters.action: Twirl a pretend fork and hum /nnn/ through your nose.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line and pull down. Go back up, hump over and down.

letters.concept: A small orange octopus curled into one perfect round ring, his arms wrapped around it and his smiling face at the bottom.
letters.action: Make a round mouth for /o/ and wiggle all ten fingers like arms.
letters.formation: Start just under the middle line. Curve back and all the way around to close the circle.

letters.concept: A gentle round dugong, the Okinawa sea cow. Her round belly is the circle and her tail rises tall on the right as the stick.
letters.action: Drum two fists on the table for each /d/.
letters.formation: Start just under the middle line and curve back around like a c. Go up to the top line and pull straight down. (Circle first, then stick.)

letters.concept: A red crab with one big open claw shaped like a c, ready to pinch a shell.
letters.action: Open and close your hand like a claw for each /k/.
letters.formation: Start just under the middle line. Curve back, around and stop. Leave it open.

letters.concept: A big kuba palm leaf curled up like a cup to catch rain, with a little stem on the right like the tail of a u.
letters.action: Point both thumbs up and push them up for each /u/.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line, pull down and curve around and up to the middle line. Pull straight down.

letters.concept: A fluffy white island goat. His round curled body is the circle and his long beard drops down and hooks back under the line.
letters.action: Touch your throat and feel /g/ bump in the back.
letters.formation: Start just under the middle line and curve back around like a c. Go up to the middle line, pull straight down below the bottom line and hook back to the left.

letters.concept: A tall banyan tree. The trunk is the tall stick and the round root ball sits at the bottom right. Bat first, then ball.
letters.action: Bounce two fists for each /b/, lips together then pop.
letters.formation: Start at the top line and pull straight down. Go back up to the middle and curve around to close at the bottom. (Stick first, then ball.)

letters.concept: A baby sea turtle hatching from a cracked egg. Her body curls around like an e and her flipper stretches straight across the middle as the line.
letters.action: Tap your fist on your palm like cracking an egg for each /e/.
letters.formation: Start in the middle. Go straight across to the right, then curve up, back and around. Stop open.

letters.concept: A red Ryukyu kingfisher standing tall. Her long body is the stick, and her wing and tail kick out from the middle like the two slants of a k.
letters.action: Do a tiny kick for each /k/.
letters.formation: Start at the top line and pull straight down. Lift. Start at the middle line on the right, slant in to touch the stick, then slant out to the bottom line.

letters.concept: A red hibiscus plant with a tall stem and one bent stem that arches down like the hump of an h.
letters.action: Hold your hand in front of your mouth and feel the warm /h/ breath.
letters.formation: Start at the top line and pull straight down. Go back up, hump over and down.

letters.concept: A little Ryukyu robin with a tall straight body and her head bent over to the right like the short curve of an r.
letters.action: Roll your fists like running and growl a soft /rrr/.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line and pull down. Go back up, curve over a little and stop.

letters.concept: A tall white island lighthouse standing straight and proud from top line to bottom line.
letters.chant: Lani the lighthouse lights the way: /lll/!
letters.action: Hold one arm straight up and sing /lll/ with your tongue behind your top teeth.
letters.formation: Start at the top line and pull straight down to the bottom line.

letters.concept: A playful sea wave that dips down and up twice like a w, with foam on each tip.
letters.action: Round your lips and wave your hand down and up for each /w/.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line. Slant down, slant up, slant down, slant up.

letters.concept: A see-through jellyfish with one long tentacle that drops below the line and hooks back, with a bubble above her head.
letters.action: Jiggle your hands like jelly for each /j/.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line and pull straight down below the bottom line. Hook back to the left. Lift and add the dot above.

letters.concept: An Okinawa purple sweet potato with two root arms in a y, the long root dropping below the line.
letters.action: Smile wide and do a yo-yo hand down and up for each /y/.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line and slant down to the right. Lift. Start at the middle line on the right and slant down all the way below the bottom line.

letters.concept: Two island sugar cane stalks crossed and tied in an x on top of a little gift box.
letters.action: Cross your arms in an x and say /ks/.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line on the left and slant down to the right. Lift. Start at the middle line on the right and slant down to the left.

letters.sound: /kw/ as in quail (q and u work together)
letters.concept: A round quail with a tail that drops below the line and flicks out. Quinn never goes anywhere without her buddy u.
letters.action: Link two pointer fingers (q and u are buddies) and say /kw/.
letters.formation: Start just under the middle line and curve back around like a c. Go up to the middle line, pull straight down below the bottom line and flick to the right.

letters.concept: Two leafy island vines that grow down and meet at a point like a v.
letters.action: Gently bite your bottom lip, hum /vvv/ and feel it buzz. Make a v with two fingers.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line. Slant down to the bottom line, then slant back up.

letters.concept: A smiling little cloud sitting on a glowing golden lightning bolt that goes across, slants down and goes across again like a z.
letters.action: Draw a zigzag in the air and buzz /zzz/ like a bee.
letters.formation: Start at the middle line and go across to the right. Slant down to the left. Go across to the right.

groups.gap_note: Only 7 real words are possible with a, m, s and t (am, at, sat, mat, Sam, Tam, mats). Fewer than 12 is expected here, so G1 adds the heart word a and repeats words in phrases for extra reading.

stage_key.picture: character beside the plain letter, letter traced over the character
stage_key.outline: plain letter with a faint character outline behind it, then the picture is covered
stage_key.plain: plain letter only: 2-3 fonts plus capital, no picture

scripts: Show Asa beside the plain letter a. Say: 'Asa makes a a shape. This is a. a says /a/.' Child traces the letter a drawn over Asa, then traces the plain a.
Show Manny beside the plain letter m. Say: 'Manny makes a m shape. This is m. m says /m/.' Child traces the letter m drawn over Manny, then traces the plain m.
Show Sami beside the plain letter s. Say: 'Sami makes a s shape. This is s. s says /s/.' Child traces the letter s drawn over Sami, then traces the plain s.
Show Tama beside the plain letter t. Say: 'Tama makes a t shape. This is t. t says /t/.' Child traces the letter t drawn over Tama, then traces the plain t.

picture_to_letter.summary: Characters help a letter stick, then fade so the child reads plain print.
steps: Intro day: character beside the plain letter. Trace the letter over the character. Script: '<Name> makes a <letter> shape. This is <letter>.'
Next day: plain letter with a faint outline of the character behind it. Then cover the picture; the child says the sound from the letter alone.
After that: plain letter only, in 2-3 fonts plus the capital. Words and sentences never have pictures.
Mistakes: give a verbal or gesture cue ('Think of Sami' + snake action), not the picture, then return to the plain letter.
